decidedBy: Djahwell chose 'map + one rating' after the RL0 feasibility check (STAGE-RL-PLAN.md RL0b)

composite.valuation_V: mean of (50 - mvrvPct)/50 and (50 - pctATH)/50; pctATH = expanding percentile (0-100) of ddATH over all Coinbase days since 2015-07-20 up to D-1, ties = mid-rank; positive = cheap
composite.trend_T: T3/10 (engine family T3: close vs rising/falling 200-day average)
composite.withheld: if any component is missing on a day, C is missing

bands.why: Set from the composite's own distribution before any outcome was read (C 5/20/50/80/95%: -0.30/-0.17/-0.01/0.19/0.35). V and T correlate -0.66, so their average rarely leaves +/-0.3; the first cuts (+/-0.3/0.6) left 86% of days neutral.

period: rows 2019-01-01 .. 2026-10-31 minus h; entry = close of D-1, Coinbase

primary.statistic: Spearman(C, forward h-day return) over all rows
primary.null: two-sided circular shift, shifts from s to N-s, s = max(h, ceil(Politis-White block of C))
primary.multiplicity: Holm across the 2 horizons at alpha 0.10
primary.pass: Holm-significant AND positive sign AND positive Spearman in both halves (2019-01..2022-12, 2023-01..end)

descriptive: partial Spearman of C given T alone (does valuation add to trend?)
mean forward return per band with circular block-bootstrap 95% interval and number of independent windows
per-indicator map of all 33 indicators (quintile profiles, halves, window counts), suppressed where fewer than 4 windows

labels.pass: Passed a one-shot test on 2019-2026 history (partly seen; forward check from first live day)
labels.fail: Did not pass on history: shown as descriptive context only

noRetry: If RLC-1 fails it is retired; no variant is tested on the same history.
